parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.lead: State the value of absolute zero on:

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: the thermodynamic temperature scale. Give a unit with your answer.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead:
A sample contains a fixed amount of gas. The gas has pressure *p*, volume *V* and thermodynamic temperature *T*.

Fig. 4.1 shows the variation of *pV* with *kT* for the sample, where *k* is the Boltzmann constant.

[[fig:f1]]
parts.text: State what is indicated about the nature of the gas from the variation shown in Fig. 4.1.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the number *N* of molecules of the gas in the sample.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answer in (b)(ii) to determine the amount *n* of gas in the sample.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The root-mean-square (r.m.s.) speed of the molecules of the gas is 190 m s⁻¹ when *pV* is equal to 270 J.

Determine the mass, in u, of one molecule of the gas, where u is the unified atomic mass unit.

figures.caption: Fig. 4.1
figures.alt: A graph of pV / J against kT / 10⁻²¹ J, with a straight line rising from the origin.
